dsh-crosstalk 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。跨会话消息：本机任意会话都可像 Claude Code 一样列出并互发消息，基于本地心跳注册表与收件箱。

posts.en:
dsh-crosstalk is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Cross-session messaging for DSH: any session on the machine can list and message any other, Claude Code-style, via a local heartbeat registry and inbox.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b142b2ed9d030ec8bef4.html
